----------------------------------------------------------
Boil-Bake Chestnut Fruitcake Recipe
----------------------------------------------------------
Ingredients:
(For Stage 1):
115g Butter or vegetable baking fat
125g Soft brown sugar (you could use white sugar if that’s what you have)
400g Mixed dried fruit – I used sultanas, raisins, dates, apricots and dried cranberries
225ml fruit juice (or water)
2 Teaspoons ground mixed spice (pudding spice/pumpkin spice)
1 Teaspoon bicarbonate of soda (baking soda)

(For stage 2)
360g Sweet
